text:
Anna: Quick sync — rehearsal for the CipherLock marketplace listing + SI joint announcement next Wed. Can we confirm SSO/SCIM/KMS demo readiness? Agenda: SSO certs, SCIM group mapping, KMS/HSM demo, embargo timing, test accounts.
Mike: Security checklist: need SAML metadata, cert rotation runbook, and the HSM FIPS attestation PDF. Also confirm least-privilege for demo service account.
Ravi: Eng update — KMS keywrap flow wired in staging. Demo script currently calls vendor SDK; example command: `cipherlock-cli wrap --key-id=ck-demo-1 --file=secrets.json` (we can replace with a thin API wrapper). Need a service account with scim:read and kms:wrap permissions.
Sophia: Product: demo should show SSO login -> auto-provision via SCIM -> keywrap -> secrets returned. Keep the UX short (30–45s). We need a fallback plan if HSM demo fails (show cached wrapped blob).
Jen: Marketing embargo: target announce Thu 2026-04-14. Assets due by Mon 2026-04-11 EOD. Need screenshots + short clip of SSO+rotate flow.
Clara: SI checklist — we need the SCIM group mapping for roles. Proposed mapping: `scim.group.displayName` -> product role (admin/dev/viewer). Also confirm whether SCIM delta sync is enabled for staging.
Ravi: SCIM delta is off in staging by default, can enable. Sample SCIM mapping snippet for testing:
```
{
  "externalId": "team-cipher",
  "displayName": "cipher-admins",
  "members": [
    {"value": "ravi@redwood.com", "type": "User"}
  ]
}
```
(we'll use a tiny script to map to /roles).
Mike: Also, rotation: show a quick manual rotation and an automated rotation test. We need audit logs in the console for key operations — ops, please ensure 30-day retention for demo accounts.
Victor: From CipherLock: we'll drop a temporary test key and provide short-lived test credentials tomorrow. I'll also attach the attestation PDF to the shared drive.
Anna: OK — action items: (1) Victor uploads attestation + creds (Victor) (2) Mike to upload SAML metadata + runbook (Mike) (3) Ravi to add demo service account + enable SCIM delta in staging (Ravi) (4) Sophia + Jen to produce 60s demo clip and screenshots (Sophia/Jen) (5) Clara to validate SCIM mapping with SI test users (Clara). Can everyone ack?
Sophia: Ack — will start storyboard today.
Mike: Ack, will post SAML metadata by EOD.
Ravi: Ack, will enable delta and create service account by tomorrow morning.
Clara: Ack — SI will test mapping Thurs.
Jen: Ack — marketing timeline noted.
Victor: Ack — creds + PDF tomorrow.
deploy-bot: release-scheduler: demo environment snapshot scheduled for 2026-04-09 03:00 UTC.
Anna: Great — last Q: do we want a short run-through with legal for embargo phrasing? Recommend quick 15m with legal on Tue.
Mike: Yes, legal should sign off on claims about FIPS/HSM.
Anna: Cool. I'll set the rehearsal invite and include demo checklist in the calendar. :thumbsup:
